test_parse_datetime: test the parse_datetime function to parse ISO 8601 datetime strings with Z suffix into UTC datetime objects
test_parse_datetime_nanoseconds: test parse_datetime truncates nanosecond precision to microseconds when parsing ISO 8601 datetime strings
test_parse_datetime_no_milliseconds: test parse_datetime handles ISO 8601 datetime strings without milliseconds by returning zero microseconds
test_parse_datetime_invalid_no_z: test parse_datetime raises ValueError when parsing ISO 8601 datetime strings missing the Z timezone suffix
test_parse_datetime_invalid_malformed: test parse_datetime raises ValueError when parsing malformed datetime strings with invalid timezone formats
